theme_central: The Night of Decree, worth more than a thousand months — the angels and the Spirit descend during it, and it is peace until the appearance of dawn.
sources_note: Universally known content, no possible divergence.

branches.title: Revelation during the Night of Decree
branches.resume: The Qur'an sent down during the Night of Decree (Laylat al-Qadr).

children.t: Revelation of the Qur'an during the Night of Decree

branches.title: Value of the Night
branches.resume: It is worth more than a thousand months.

children.t: The Night of Decree is worth more than a thousand months

branches.title: Descent of the angels, peace
branches.resume: The angels and the Spirit descend during it with Allah's permission; it is peace until dawn.
